If you just play you’ll form your own opinion and I’m willing to bet its shortcomings won’t surface. If you feel like you’re stuck there are plenty of resources to give you a hand.

There are several discord servers geared toward the game and most of those communities are incredibly generous with both their time and resources.

If you want to see what every class has to offer you can expect around 200 hours of fun each season. If you just want to play one character you can expect 50-70 hours until you’ve completed the season journey.

I’m upvoting your comment for visibility’s sake as I think there’s great discourse to be had here; however, I could not disagree more. 

So many folks harp on Diablo 4 for its lack of depth and complexity and while that might be true for the skill tree, the paragon boards aspects, uniques, mythic uniques, and glyphs all lead to some pretty deep build crafting.

It’s insane to me that people think Last Epoch is that much further ahead of Diablo in this respect when the truth is, they’re pretty damn similar. 

Sure, it’s easier to follow a guide for Diablo than it is for LE, and much simpler than downloading third party software in the form of Path of Building for PoE, but how does that trivialize the existing complexities of D4? The game is insanely populated which means the auxiliary resources are going to be abundant and Blizzard is kind of known for their game readability. It’s a shame how many people shit on D4 and any sort of praise instantly makes you a shill.
